# VICTORY LANE — cinematic scroll site

Award-style "3D scroll" one-pager for Victory Lane (premium car workshop, Ahmedabad).
Off-black + gold, Cormorant Garamond display serif + Archivo sans, Lenis smooth scroll,
GSAP ScrollTrigger, and Apple-style canvas frame-sequence scrubbing.

**Current visuals are procedural placeholders** (gold wireframe hologram car) generated by
`tools/generate-placeholders.mjs`. They exist so every scroll mechanic is real and testable.
The final films come from Google Flow — prompts in [`PROMPTS.md`](PROMPTS.md).

## Run it

```bash
node server.mjs          # serves on http://localhost:4173
```

No build step. Everything (fonts, GSAP, Lenis, frames) is local/self-contained.

## Page structure

| Section | Effect |
|---|---|
| Hero | Pinned 400vh; "VICTORY LANE" letters track in; hero orbit scrubbed frame-by-frame with scroll |
| Story | Pinned; three serif lines hand over as you scroll |
| Macro | Pinned 320vh; macro fly-through scrubbed; 3 callouts timed to scrub position |
| Engineering | Pinned 380vh; exploded assembly scrubbed; 4 service callouts + stats strip |
| Signature | Ambient atmosphere loop (plays only while visible) |
| Reserve | Waitlist/appointment form + footer |

## Swapping in the real Google Flow footage

1. Put the MP4s in `incoming/` named `hero.mp4`, `macro.mp4`, `assembly.mp4`, `atmosphere.mp4`.
2. From `tools/`:
   ```bash
   node video-to-frames.mjs ../incoming/hero.mp4 hero
   node video-to-frames.mjs ../incoming/macro.mp4 macro
   node video-to-frames.mjs ../incoming/assembly.mp4 assembly
   node video-to-frames.mjs ../incoming/atmosphere.mp4 atmosphere
   ```
3. Hard-refresh. The site reads `frames/<seq>/manifest.json` — no code changes needed.

Frames are extracted at ≤200 per clip, 1600px wide, JPEG q3. Bump `maxFrames`
(third argument) for silkier scrubbing on longer clips.
